infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: RSM Messenger uses camera for photos, videos, and video calling.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: RSM Messenger uses microphone for voice notes and calls.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: RSM Messenger needs photo library access to send pictures and videos.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: RSM Messenger needs location to share your location with contacts.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: RSM Messenger needs contacts access to discover your friends on the platform.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow RSM Messenger to access your photos to send images.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow RSM Messenger to access your camera to take pictures.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow RSM Messenger to access your location to share with contacts.

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow RSM Messenger to sync your contacts.
